mistakes.text: The veranda, which she now spends every morning, faces the sunrise.
mistakes.normalized: the veranda which she now spends every morning faces the sunrise
mistakes.feedback_sk: Miesto vyjadrí „where“ alebo „on which“. Samotné „which“ tu nestačí.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Místo vyjádří „where“ nebo „on which“. Samotné „which“ tu nestačí.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a place use “where” or “on which”; “which” alone doesn't work here.

mistakes.text: The veranda, where she now spends every morning on, faces the sunrise.
mistakes.normalized: the veranda where she now spends every morning on faces the sunrise
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Where“ už obsahuje predložku, „on“ na konci je navyše.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Where“ už obsahuje předložku, „on“ na konci je navíc.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Where” already includes the preposition, so drop “on” at the end.

mistakes.text: The veranda, on which she now spends every morning on, faces the sunrise.
mistakes.normalized: the veranda on which she now spends every morning on faces the sunrise
mistakes.feedback_sk: Predložka „on“ je dvakrát. Nechaj ju buď pred „which“, alebo na konci.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Předložka „on“ je dvakrát. Nech ji buď před „which“, nebo na konci.
mistakes.feedback_en: “On” appears twice; keep it either before “which” or at the end.

mistakes.text: The veranda, that she now spends every morning on, faces the sunrise.
mistakes.normalized: the veranda that she now spends every morning on faces the sunrise
mistakes.feedback_sk: Non-defining clause medzi čiarkami nezačína „that“: použi „where“ alebo „on which“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Non-defining clause mezi čárkami nezačíná „that“: použij „where“ nebo „on which“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “That” can't start a non-defining clause (between commas); use “where” or “on which”.

mistakes.text: The veranda, where she spends now every morning, faces the sunrise.
mistakes.normalized: the veranda where she spends now every morning faces the sunrise
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Now“ nepatrí medzi sloveso a predmet: „she now spends every morning“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Now“ nepatří mezi sloveso a předmět: „she now spends every morning“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't put “now” between the verb and its object: “she now spends every morning”.

mistakes.text: The veranda, where she now spends every morning, is turned to the sunrise.
mistakes.normalized: the veranda where she now spends every morning is turned to the sunrise
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Is turned to“ znie doslovne. Po anglicky sa povie „faces the sunrise“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Is turned to“ zní doslovně. Anglicky se řekne „faces the sunrise“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Is turned to” sounds like a word-for-word translation; English says “faces the sunrise”.
